- For words and expressions used in the project-specific Specification clauses which are intended to mean the defined words and expressions under GCC Clause 1.1 and other clauses of GCC for building works contracts, ensure the defined words and expressions under GCC are adopted and the capitalization thereof (if applicable) is followed wherever it suits the Contract Team's intention. Some non-exhaustive examples include - - "site" (vs. "Site" under GCC Clause 1.1); - "works" (vs. "Works" under GCC Clause 1.1); - "contract" (vs. "Contract" under GCC Clause 1.1); - "utility companies" / "utility undertakers" (vs. "Utility Undertaking" under GCC Clause 1.1); - "date of commencement of the Works" / "commencement of the Contract" (vs. "the notified date for commencement of the Works" under GCC Clause 8.1), etc.

- Avoid using statement such as "no claims for extension of time or cost or whatsoever will be entertained" in the project-specific Specification clauses since whether the Contractor is entitled to extension of time and/or additional costs is governed by the Conditions of Contract.

As a gentle reminder, where the works described in PRE clauses are stated with phrases like "when instructed / if instructed / as instructed by the CM", such kind of descriptions may be interpreted by the Contractor as either - (i) the works is required and provided for under the Contract, while the timing of execution or the actual location of the works is subject to the CM's instruction, or (ii) the work itself is provisional or optional and may not be required. For the case where the Contract Team considers the works are to be executed certainly (only the exact timing or location of the works is yet to be ascertained), but the Contractor interprets such works "if instructed" as optional, the Contractor may argue that the subsequent CM's instruction for confirmation of timing of execution or location of such works constitutes a Variation under the Contract. In the former case (i), avoid the use of phrases like "if instructed" or similar for the works to be executed certainly. If the Contract Team intends to clarify that the exact timing or location of the required works is yet to be ascertained, please consider stating that the exact timing of execution or the location of the works is subject to CM's direction. In the latter case (ii), PQS is to review whether works that are described as "if instructed" or similar in PRE clauses shall, where they are optional, be measured separately in the Bills of Quantities as items of provisional quantity as appropriate.

Whether an area is outside estate boundary or the Contractor will only be given non-exclusive possession of an area or the Contractor will have to obtain permission from Government departments/other parties to carry out the Works in an area will not prevent such area from being included within the boundary of the Site. The Contract Team should only consider the works as "works outside the boundary of the Site" in exceptional case.
